entries.title: Medieval Dynasty
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release with latest updates and relevant DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Oxbow/co-op updates and current DLC/update content
primary.why: Medieval Dynasty launched on Windows PC before expanding to current-gen consoles, legacy consoles, and a separate Meta Quest VR spin-off. The PC release remains the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings ceiling and the current update/DLC path, including Oxbow/co-op content, Echoes of Nature, Exquisite Pack, and the 2026 Full Stock update.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC build through Steam or another current PC storefront, install the latest patch, and include relevant paid DLC if the archive run is meant to document the current complete content set. Treat New Settlement as a separate VR spin-off, not a replacement.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the strongest settings/capture route, co-op support, current updates, and the broadest DLC storefront visibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most complete current archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-gen console route with Oxbow/co-op and later update support.
all_releases.reason: secondary: strong convenience/couch route, but lower archive control than PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-gen console route with Oxbow/co-op and Game Pass/Microsoft Store availability.
all_releases.reason: secondary: strong convenience/couch route, but lower archive control than PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Legacy console route documented as available, but not the preferred current archive path.
all_releases.reason: skip: use current-gen console or PC instead for better fidelity and update confidence.

all_releases.platform: Meta Quest 2 / Meta Quest 3 / Meta Quest Pro
all_releases.fidelity: Standalone VR spin-off, not a port of the main flat-screen game.
all_releases.reason: skip: separate VR experience; add as its own entry if the archive later tracks VR spin-offs.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive main-game content was found; PC is the fidelity-first route and the cleanest current content path.

entries.remaster_caveats: New Settlement is a standalone VR spin-off, not a remaster or replacement. Oxbow, Full Stock, and paid packs are updates/DLC for the main game rather than separate entries.
